name: Makera Carvera Air
notes: EU store price (5th-anniversary sale; regular €2,749). Guides are mixed: X/Y 20 mm hardened chrome-plated rods, Z 15 mm linear rail; ball screws on all axes. Weight 30 kg per spec table (manual: ~35 kg net). Accuracy = stated resolution. Quick manual tool change with custom collet (1/8" standard; 1/4", 6, 4, 3 mm optional). Wired Z probe and automatic tool setter included. Needs an external dust collector; supports external air assist. Optional 4th axis (Ø92 × 200 mm) and 5 W laser.

accessories.name: Carvera Air 4th Axis Module
accessories.description: Harmonic-drive rotary module for simultaneous 4-axis machining on the Carvera Air (Ø92 × 200 mm).

accessories.name: Carvera Air Laser Module
accessories.description: 5 W 445 nm diode laser head for engraving and cutting thin materials; includes safety goggles.

accessories.name: Makera 3D Wired Probe
accessories.description: 3D touch probe for edge, centre and surface finding on metal and non-metal workpieces.

accessories.name: Makera Cyclone Dust Collector
accessories.description: Full-size cyclone dust collector with automated control for long, continuous milling jobs.

accessories.name: Makera Cyclone Dust Collector Lite
accessories.description: Compact cyclone dust collector with automated machine control; the recommended extractor for the Z1.

accessories.name: Makera Fixture Set for Carvera & Carvera Air
accessories.description: Two side clamps and a thick L-bracket for holding workpieces thicker than 2 cm.
